extension.description: XSCleaner keeps your Kodi installation clean and fast. Features include cache cleanup, thumbnail management, database optimization, backup/restore, advanced settings editor, and more.
XSCleaner hält Ihre Kodi-Installation sauber und schnell. Funktionen umfassen Cache-Bereinigung, Thumbnail-Verwaltung, Datenbank-Optimierung, Backup/Restore, Advanced Settings Editor und mehr.
extension.disclaimer: Use at your own risk. Always backup before making changes.
Verwendung auf eigene Gefahr. Erstellen Sie vor Änderungen immer ein Backup.
extension.news: v1.3.2 - Golden Master / Release v1.3.2b - Fix: Backup restore writes settings and databases back to the correct userdata location - Fix: Fresh Start no longer deletes the XSCleaner addon or its dependencies - Fix: Database orphan cleanup no longer fails with an SQL syntax error (GROUP BY *) - Fix: Celebrity/Artist cache cleanup no longer clears the actorlink table - Fix: Favorites Manager correctly recognizes RunAddon entries and Kodi return parameters - Fix: Orphan artwork cleanup no longer treats image:// and remote URLs as broken - Fix: Auto-update check now parses version suffixes (e.g. 1.3.1b) and is run by the service - Fix: Search history cleanup actually clears recent searches in guisettings.xml - Fix: "Addons + Data" backup now includes addons and addon data (was data only) - Fix: Performance tips now match storage entries correctly in all languages - Fix: Startup Manager parses the JSON-RPC enabled state reliably; Kodi version detection no longer crashes when BuildVersion is unavailable - Fix: Sources check parses sources.xml only once and writes valid UTF-8 XML with proper indentation (Kodi 19 compatible) - Fix: Advanced settings XML is written with UTF-8 declaration, compatible with Python 3.8 - Fix: Crash log subfolders are only removed when they actually contain crash dumps; freed space is now counted correctly - Fix: Log viewer reads only the tail of the log file instead of the whole file - Fix: Dashboard total now shows the actual home folder size - Fix: Auto cleanup is skipped when Kodi shuts down during the startup delay - Perf: Dashboard storage sizes are cached for 10 minutes and invalidated after cleanups - Perf: Thumbnail database rows are deleted in batches of 500 instead of one by one - Perf: Duplicate-row cleanup skips tables with more than 500k rows and logs duration - Perf: Empty-folder cleanup stops early when a pass removed nothing - Cleanup: Removed dead code, unused imports and 53 unused localization strings v1.3.1b - Database optimization now requires a configured backup path - Database backups use the Backup & Restore system format (restorable) v1.3.0b - HTTP/Image, weather, downloads, search history cache cleanup - Celebrity/Artist cache cleanup & Textures13.db rebuild - Favorites Manager & unused language cleanup - Performance tips, system addon protection, remote URL support v1.2.0b - TMDBHelper cache database cleanup - Database Optimize sub-dialog now setting-aware v1.1.0b - Activity logging with audit trail - Version-aware advanced settings editor (Kodi 19-20 vs 21+) - RAM detection for auto-calculated cache values - Settings now actually control menu visibility and execution - Service with interval-based auto cleanup - Cross-platform cache cleanup rewritten - German localization corrected v1.0.0b - Initial release with cache, thumbnails, addons, packages, crash logs cleanup - Database optimization (VACUUM, integrity check) - Advanced Settings editor, Backup/Restore, Fresh Start - Dashboard, Log Viewer, Startup Manager, System Info - Auto cleanup service - German and English language support
